responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s symbolic constraint system over svalues. This file manages equivalence classes, ordering and inequality constraints, integer ranges and bounded switch ranges, evaluates conditions, canonicalizes and merges constraint sets, replays constraints through call summaries, and includes extensive selftests for transitivity, range reasoning, bitmask handling, and satisfiability behavior that underpin path feasibility and state splitting.
same_name_distinction: Contains the implementation of the constraint system declared in constraint-manager.h, including range and constraint evaluation, canonicalization, satisfiability logic, call-summary replay support, and the file’s analyzer selftests.
